questions.passage: More than simply putting flowers in a [BLANK], Ikebana is a [BLANK] art form that encompasses the aesthetic principles of Japanese culture. Rather than a multicolored [BLANK] of blossoms, Ikebana often uses other areas of the [BLANK], such as stems, leaves, and branches, as design elements.
questions.question: 아래 단어 중 알맞은 것을 골라 빈칸을 채우세요.
questions.explanation:
【Collocation 패턴 정리】

✅ container
패턴: flowers in a container / put in a container
비슷한 표현: vase(꽃병), pot(화분), container(용기)
예문: She placed the flowers in a glass container.

✅ disciplined
패턴: disciplined art form / highly disciplined practice
예문: Ballet is a highly disciplined art form.
❌ creative → disciplined (문맥상 '체계적/규율 있는'이 맞음)

✅ arrangement
패턴: flower arrangement / arrangement of flowers / a multicolored arrangement
예문: She made a beautiful flower arrangement.
❌ collection → arrangement (arrangement는 의도적 배열, collection은 모음)

✅ plant
패턴: parts of a plant / areas of the plant / other parts of the plant
예문: The leaves are important parts of the plant.
❌ flower → plant (flower는 꽃 자체, plant는 식물 전체 — stems/leaves/branches 포함)
questions.memo: Collocation | flowers in a container / disciplined art form / flower arrangement / parts of a plant

questions.question: 【Collocation 복습】 다음 중 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
핵심 Collocation 4가지:
• flowers in a container — 꽃을 용기에 넣다
• disciplined art form — 규율 있는 예술 형식 (체계적/규칙 있는)
• flower arrangement — 꽃꽂이 / 의도적 배열
• parts of a plant — 식물의 부분 (stems, leaves, branches 모두 포함)
